from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
import numpy as np

model = SentenceTransformer("{{embed_model}}")

def search(query: str, corpus: list[str]) -> list[tuple[str, float]]:
    qv = model.encode([query], normalize_embeddings=True)
    cv = model.encode(corpus, normalize_embeddings=True)
    sims = (cv @ qv.T).flatten()
    idx = np.argsort(-sims)[:{{top_k}}]
    return [(corpus[i], float(sims[i])) for i in idx]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(search("cat", ["a dog", "a kitten", "a car"]))
